import numpy as np

def score_merge_static(distance_matrix, demands, capacity, i_idx, j_idx):
    """Return a 1D array of finite float priority scores (higher = merge earlier)."""
    D = np.asarray(distance_matrix, dtype=np.float64)
    d0i = D[0, i_idx]
    d0j = D[0, j_idx]
    dij = D[i_idx, j_idx]
    savings = d0i + d0j - dij

    n = D.shape[0] - 1
    if n >= 2:
        mask = ~np.eye(n + 1, dtype=bool)
        off = D[mask]
        ref = float(np.mean(off)) if off.size > 0 else 1.0
    else:
        ref = 1.0
    if not np.isfinite(ref) or ref <= 0.0:
        ref = 1.0

    score = savings / (ref + 1e-12)
    return np.where(np.isfinite(score), score, 0.0).astype(np.float64)
